claims.text: I&D is the treatment for an abscess; antibiotics alone are almost always inadequate.
claims.quote: I&D = Tx for abscess - abx alone almost always inadequate

claims.text: A deep abscess may feel only indurated: use needle aspiration or ultrasound.
claims.quote: deep abscess may feel just indurated w.o definite mass → needle aspiration or US

claims.text: Incision: linear, along the long axis at peak fluctuance, following skin creases.
claims.quote: linear incision along LONG AXIS of abscess, length of peak fluctuance - conform to skin creases/folds

claims.text: Break up loculations with a hemostat or cotton swab, then irrigate.
claims.quote: blunt dissection to disrupt internal loculations (fibrous septa): hemostat or cotton swab - irrigation

claims.text: Culture if immunocompromised, MRSA is suspected, or there is local resistance.
claims.quote: consider: immunocompromised - suspect MRSA - hx local resistance (hospital/health dept)

claims.text: Take aerobic and anaerobic cultures from inside the abscess.
claims.quote: aerobic AND anaerobic - get from INSIDE the abscess, not just what drains out

claims.text: Packing: insert loosely with a tail, cover, leave in 48 hours.
claims.quote: insert gauze LOOSELY, leave tail hanging - cover w absorbent gauze - leave in 48 h
